prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in an empty sunlit stadium with green turf, a running track, standard-height gates and low stands behind her, evenly lit by soft overcast light, shadows very soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in soft overcast daylight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Spanish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, soft pastel-pink hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a lead ship's anchor, a bronze square-sided cowbell, a silver pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three gold necklaces. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a white ruffled lace maid headband, a black lace choker with a small bow and white lace wrist cuffs, a micro strapless black satin bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal black satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Italian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a tin barrel-shaped weight, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered mixed-metal rings. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge and two silver dog-tag chains around her neck, a micro strapless camouflage-pattern bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal camouflage-pattern micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material glowing softly under the diffused light, the gentle light modelling every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
